question: Will Apple announce a Smart Home Hub on Oct 13, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Apple publicly announces a Smart Home Hub product (including any device marketed or described as a smart home hub, home hub, or equivalent central smart-home display/controller) on an official Apple channel strictly after 2026-10-12T22:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-13T22:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if no such announcement is made on an official Apple channel strictly after 2026-10-12T22:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-13T22:00:00Z.

Clarifications:
- An "official Apple channel" includes Apple Newsroom (apple.com/newsroom), Apple's official website product pages, and any Apple-hosted press event or live stream occurring within the window.
- A product qualifies as a "Smart Home Hub" if it is positioned as a dedicated home-control display device integrating smart-home management (e.g., HomeKit control, Siri AI interaction, video calls), regardless of the specific product name Apple uses (e.g., "HomePad," "Home Hub," or similar).
